easy.parameters: m,n in {1,2}; nonzero h,k in {-2,-1,1,2}; reject actual zero coordinate constants and equivalent graphs

moderate.workload: Both coordinates are factored quadratics on five integer parameter values. Compare the whole paired curve with sign and omitted-shift errors. Same substitution/table/sketch method as the sources.

hard.workload: Same factored coordinate pair and table method. All choices lie on the same joint quadratic locus and differ only in the closed parameter interval; identify both included endpoints to distinguish the complete graph.

finite_limits: Moderate and hard share 96 parameter combinations and their correct loci overlap. They are not 192 distinct tasks. Deduplicate globally across difficulty, bank, source, seed and identity before selection.
The 64 opaque source wrong-graph formulas have not been recovered. Observed banks are replay-only at the exact original parameters and assets; they cannot replenish inventory with new identities.
difficulty_evidence: Only easy is source-observed. Moderate and hard are bounded authored recognition demands, documented in classification.md; no empirical difficulty calibration is claimed.
shortage_policy: Select only distinct complete correct loci/domains. A bounded failure leaves its shortage explicit; no seed, UUID, option-order or bank-only padding.
validation: validation.json; every selected instance additionally passes displayed-math/table checks, five-graph uniqueness, deterministic replay and current native grading before database preparation.
